name: flow-rms
description: FLOW - Yerel ağda çalışan Restoran Yönetim Sistemi

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db:setup:prod -w server && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,graph -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run graph:watch"
